execution.signal_clock: confirm_close_ms is the UTC close time of a completed 5m candle and the next 5m bar open timestamp
execution.end_of_data: mark at the last continuous 5m close, classify as censored cutoff_mark, and do not charge a hypothetical exit fee
execution.intrabar_path: adverse first: long O-L-H-C, short O-H-L-C; monotone native segments
execution.target_admission: strictly ahead of entry in the trade direction; otherwise retain as a pretrade skip

fees.funding: actual Binance fundingRate and markPrice at fundingTime

accounts.order: settle funding, settle exits, then admit entries; equal-time entries sort by symbol then trade_id
accounts.marking: 5m OHLC and closes; account NAV includes unrealized price PnL and settled funding

array_format: Each tape_path is a NumPy array of integer UTC open_ms plus open, high, low, close. The event tape must include the confirmation candle and next-open bar. Registered local bars extend it to 168 hours when available; less coverage is a censored cutoff mark, not an entry exclusion.
limitations: Native execution uses synthetic full liquidity with whole-unit framework sizing; the shared account rescales fills to its fractional base-asset quantity.
No spread, slippage, exchange lot-size rounding, market impact, liquidation, or maintenance margin is modeled.
5m OHLC order is a deterministic adverse-first path, not tick data; simultaneous cross-symbol OHLC extrema form a conservative envelope rather than a synchronized path.
Positions still open at a data cutoff remain marked and reserved through the account cutoff; later target/stop execution is unknown.
